name: Primary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Adulthood

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 2018 Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonia Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Progressive dyspnea and non-productive cough in adult patients
High-resolution CT showing usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) or other characteristic interstitial patterns
Exclusion of known causes of interstitial lung disease such as connective tissue disease, environmental exposures, or drug toxicity
Surgical lung biopsy showing characteristic histopathological features when diagnosis is uncertain
Restrictive ventilatory defect and reduced diffusing capacity on pulmonary function testing

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical presentation, typical HRCT pattern, and exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is reserved for cases with inconclusive imaging and clinical findings.

searchTerms: worsening shortness of breath with activity
weakness related to low blood oxygen

occasional.symptomName: Weight loss due to chronic illness

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary hypertension symptoms (e.g., syncope, chest pain)
searchTerms: symptoms of high lung blood pressure
fainting and chest pain from lung hypertension
shortness of breath with chest discomfort

rare.notes: May suggest underlying connective tissue disease

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP)
Exclusion of autoimmune serologies (ANA, RF, anti-CCP) to rule out secondary causes
imaging: High-resolution CT showing reticular opacities, honeycombing, and traction bronchiectasis predominantly in subpleural and basal lung regions
genetic: Rare familial cases linked to mutations in surfactant protein genes (e.g., SFTPC) and telomerase-related genes (e.g., TERT, TERC)
other: Pulmonary function tests showing restrictive pattern with reduced total lung capacity and decreased diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)

distinguishingFeatures: Extrapulmonary manifestations such as arthritis or skin changes
Presence of granulomas on lung biopsy

redFlags: Onset of hemoptysis or acute exacerbation
references: American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society International Multidisciplinary Consensus Classification of the Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias, 2013
Orphanet: Primary Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Adulthood, ORPHA:264740
Cottin V, et al. Interstitial lung diseases in adults. Lancet. 2018
